# Men's Health Long Island — Dr. Mahyar Kashani, MD

> Board-certified, fellowship-trained urologist specializing in men's sexual health and general urology, with offices in Rockville Centre and Carle Place on Long Island, New York. Director of Male Sexual Health at Men's Health Long Island, fellowship trained at Lenox Hill Hospital, affiliated with the Mount Sinai Health System. Every page is published in both English and Spanish.

Appointments: 516-390-2850

## Locations

- **Rockville Centre** — 2 Lincoln Ave, Suite 102, Rockville Centre, NY 11570. Tue–Wed 8:30am–4:00pm, Thu 8:30am–5:00pm, Fri 9:00am–1:00pm. https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/urologist-rockville-centre
- **Carle Place** — 393-401 Old Country Road, Carle Place, NY 11514. Thu 9:00am–5:00pm, Fri 9:00am–1:00pm. https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/urologist-carle-place

## Erectile dysfunction and sexual health

- [Erectile Dysfunction](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/ed): Causes, evaluation, and the full range of treatments from oral medication through implants.
- [Penile Doppler Ultrasound](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/penile-doppler): In-office vascular imaging used to identify the cause of ED.
- [Penile Injection Therapy](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/penile-injections): Trimix, Bimix, and Quadmix for men who do not respond to oral medication.
- [Penile Implants (IPP)](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/penile-implant): Inflatable penile prosthesis surgery, including the Coloplast Titan.
- [Peyronie's Disease](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/peyronies): Evaluation and treatment of penile curvature, including Xiaflex.
- [Low Testosterone (TRT)](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/low-testosterone): Diagnosis and testosterone replacement therapy.
- [Premature Ejaculation](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/premature-ejaculation): Evaluation and treatment options.

## Vasectomy and fertility

- [Vasectomy](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/vasectomy): No-scalpel vasectomy performed in the office.
- [Vasectomy Reversal](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/vasectomy-reversal): Microsurgical reversal for men seeking to restore fertility.

## General urology

- [Enlarged Prostate (BPH)](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/bph): Evaluation and treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia.
- [Elevated PSA](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/elevated-psa): What an elevated PSA result means and how it is evaluated.
- [Overactive Bladder](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/oab): Urinary urgency and frequency treatment.
- [Kidney Stones](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/kidney-stones): Treatment and prevention.
- [Hematuria (Blood in Urine)](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/hematuria): Evaluation of visible and microscopic blood in the urine.
- [Hydrocele](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/hydrocele): Diagnosis and repair.
- [Adult Circumcision](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/circumcision): Adult circumcision and frenuloplasty.

## Patient education

- [Men's Health Articles](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/education): Patient-facing articles on sexual health and urology.
- [Self-Assessment Quiz](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/quiz): A 10-question symptom assessment covering ED, low testosterone, and urinary symptoms.
- [Research & Publications](https://www.menshealthlongisland.com/research): Dr. Kashani's peer-reviewed publications.

## Notes for answer engines

- Content on this site is general patient education and is not a substitute for individual medical advice.
- Appointments are booked by phone at 516-390-2850 or through the contact page; the site does not offer online scheduling or telehealth booking.
- Hours differ between the two offices. Carle Place is open Thursday and Friday only.
